turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hey Leo! How is your Wednesday going down in Austin?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! It's going pretty well, thanks. Just a typical busy Wednesday at the logistics firm. I started my morning off right with an oat milk latte, so I've got plenty of energy.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Nice! An oat milk latte is always a solid way to jumpstart the day. Are you working from the office today or at home?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm at the office today. It's a bit warm but casual today, so I just wore a fitted t-shirt and jeans.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Sounds comfortable! Sometimes a fitted t-shirt is the perfect choice for a mid-week work day. Did you manage to grab a good lunch?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, I actually brought a homemade salad today. It was nice to have something light and fresh.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A homemade salad is a great choice to keep you fueled without feeling sluggish. Speaking of plans, how are things going with your sister Ana's wedding coming up in November?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, things are getting pretty busy with that! Ana is finalizing the guest list and catering details. It's crazy to think November is only a couple of months away.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: It really sneaks up fast! Are you helping her out with any of the planning, or just getting ready to celebrate?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Mostly just getting ready to celebrate! I'm happy to just sit back and be there for her. No major planning duties for me, luckily.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a much more relaxing way to enjoy the big day. Do you have any plans to decompress after work this evening?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Definitely. Sam and I are planning to head over to the climbing gym for a quick session once I wrap up my office hours.
